highlights.title: Fewer safety prompts reach you
highlights.line: A Claude Code safety check on an agent's plan file is now approved for you, and one left to you is a card line, not a phone buzz.

highlights.title: Mac agent restarts say why
highlights.line: When a Claude agent's process stops on the Mac and Kosmos starts it again, its card now says when and why.

highlights.title: A file that did not arrive whole is refused
highlights.line: A file sent from the board that arrives incomplete is refused, saying how much arrived; a document missing its end is marked to send again.

highlights.title: Account moves ask for a handoff first
highlights.line: Moving an agent to another account now asks it to write a handoff first, and its new session is pointed at it.
